name: Covert Extraction
summary: Myrokos Silentform seeks two Perenolde heirlooms in the ruins of Alterac. The Syndicate is after them too.

sections.title: The Heirlooms
sections.body: In the ruins of Alterac, Myrokos Silentform wants you to recover two heirlooms of House Perenolde. The Blade of House Perenolde and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde lie in two towers, according to a report. The Syndicate seeks them as well, while ogres occupy the ruins. Myrokos asks you to bring both relics to him.

faq.answer: Myrokos Silentform wants you to retrieve the Blade of House Perenolde and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde.
They are the Blade of House Perenolde, a sword, and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde, a shield.
A report places the Blade of House Perenolde and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde in two towers among the ruins of Alterac.
The Syndicate is also after the two Perenolde heirlooms, so Myrokos wants you to acquire them first.
Ogres occupy the ruins of Alterac.
